name: Star Rating (Display)
summary: Read-only star visualization for a supplied rating value with default and large presentation options.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Read-only inline rating group with an accessible text alternative.

anatomy.name: star
anatomy.description: Repeated decorative star glyph or icon marked empty, filled, or half-filled by the adapter.

properties.name: ratingValue
properties.description: Read-only rating value represented by the decorative stars; this component does not calculate aggregates.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible text alternative containing the supplied value and rating scale.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Star presentation size selected from the registry-backed options; default is the contract default.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Registry default size list retained for compatibility; the registry models visual size through variants.

behavior.name: readOnlyValue
behavior.description: The adapter projects the supplied half-step value into decorative star states while preserving the complete value as accessible text.

behavior.name: decorativeStars
behavior.description: Individual stars are hidden from assistive technology when the root already exposes the rating label.

accessibility: Expose the full rating value and scale through readable text or the root accessible label.
Hide individual decorative star glyphs from assistive technology when the root supplies the complete label.
Do not use Star Rating for value entry; use Star Input for an interactive rating choice.
Do not rely on star color alone when the rating value must be understood.

web.notes: Read-only visual states are implemented in components/css/reviews.css.

shopify.notes: A future adapter may map target-supplied values without owning aggregation.
